summary: Partition Composer footer width coverage into three 27-composer stories per theme without changing validation deadlines or geometry assertions

replay.detail: Story fixtures only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: Composer product behavior and policy combinations are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: FooterWidthBudget and FooterWidthBudgetLight story IDs are replaced by Narrow (320px), Medium (360px), and Wide (451px) stories and their Light aliases. Critical case policy, exemption inventory and receipt count pins migrate together.

manual.detail: Use the width-specific Storybook links when reviewing footer containment; each still covers every layout, target and running-policy corner.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes or recovery actions.
